tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the SaaS Radar directory of software reviewed for French-speaking entrepreneurs, freelancers and small businesses. Give a need ('invoicing for freelancers', 'cold email', 'CRM') or a product name, optionally a category slug from list_categories and filters. Returns up to `limit` tools ordered

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full SaaS Radar review of one tool, by slug (from search_tools) or exact name: description, verdict, Radar Score, pros and cons, key features, who it is for and not for, pricing tiers, free plan limits, GDPR, data hosting, vendor, integrations, FAQ and promo code. Includes the listing `url`, a raw M

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every SaaS Radar category with at least one published tool: name, slug (to pass to search_tools), number of tools and page URL.

tools.name: list_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to one tool, as selected by the SaaS Radar editor (not computed), by slug or exact name. Returns the same fields as search_tools. An empty list means no alternatives were validated yet: use search_tools with the tool's category.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_categories · Public sink: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_categories · Public sink: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
